item.title: Legacy Standard Bible, A Faithful and Precise Translation with Justin Peters
item.description: In this episode of Sound Theology & Discernment, Justin Peters discusses the Legacy Standard Bible and its commitment to faithful, precise translation. This conversation explores the origins of the LSB, its formal equivalence philosophy, and why accuracy, consistency, and transparency to the original biblical languages matter for preaching and teaching.

item.title: Esther 8, Deliverance Decreed
item.description: In Esther 8, God’s providence turns death into deliverance. This episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave explores God’s sovereign decree, restored joy, and gospel hope in Christ.

item.description: In Esther 9, God turns sorrow into joy as He delivers His people and establishes Purim. This episode highlights God’s providence and Christ’s victory.

item.title: The Battle for the Bible and the Call to Discernment
item.description: As we conclude our December series on the 2025 State of Theology, Dave Jenkins addresses growing doctrinal confusion and explains why the deeper crisis is ultimately about the authority of God’s Word. This episode calls Christians to trained biblical discernment and offers practical ways to stand firm with clarity and conviction as we head into 2026.
